key_facts: UPDATED Aug 15 (T+1d FINAL DAY to Aug 16 finish; SUBMITTED POST-ROUND 3 UPDATE): Round 3 complete at TPC Southwind (BBC Sport, Palm Beach Post, Golf Channel, Sky Sports, RTE, Fox Sports Aug 15; 18 holes remaining!).
